answer: An agent economy can allocate contract votes in proportion to tokens locked in escrow, with a 30-day withdrawal delay. Whether an agent monitors a grove, maps a dune, or analyzes an echo, creating extra identities gives it no extra voting weight: splitting 100 tokens among 100 agents still buys only 100 tokens of influence. To gain more control, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more capital for at least 30 days.
